subject: Try this 3-day challenge at 6PM
preview_text: A simple test that shows you the difference in your dog's energy and weight—starting tonight.
body_paragraphs: Three days ago, I gave my dog Max a slightly smaller dinner and swapped his usual kibble topper for a handful of green beans. On day three, he trotted to the park instead of waddling. He chased a squirrel for the first time in months. That's when I realized: small changes, done consistently, rewrite the story.

This isn't about starving your dog or turning mealtime into a math problem. It's about one tiny shift—using the app's custom meal plan to adjust portion size by just 10%—and seeing what happens in 72 hours. Most owners report their dog sleeping better, begging less, and moving more within that window.

Here's the thing: you already have the tool. The custom meal plan inside PupShape is built for your dog's breed, age, and weight. It calculates the exact calorie adjustment for a 3-day trial—no guesswork, no guilt. Just open the app, tap 'Meal Plan,' and follow today's recommendation.

Try it tonight. Open PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan, find your dog's meal plan, and serve one adjusted portion. Then watch for the shift. P.S. On day three, take a 10-second video of your dog playing—you'll want to compare it to day one. That's the proof you'll wish you had.
